name: co.didimo.ivh.humanoids
description: Humanoid 3D character package for the Intelligent Virtual Humans SDK (IVH SDK), developed by Didimo for the PRESENCE project.

samples.description: Demo scene showcasing every character prefab in the package, with baked lighting, reflection probes, environment and skybox. Requires the Universal Render Pipeline to be configured with Runtime/Settings/Mobile_High.asset.

Reference material, not a runnable demo. Three separate scenes, each solving the same problem in a different way: hiding a humanoid's head from its own first-person camera while keeping it visible to every other camera. Requires two project-level setup steps documented in the sample's README.
